NAME DISAMBIGUATION MATTERED HERE: 'Anurag/Anuraag Reddy' is a common Telugu name and a US-based Dr Anurag Reddy (haematologist-oncologist, Kokomo, Indiana) surfaced in results; he was excluded on country, hospital and the distinctive 'Nalla' surname prefix, which is the double-barrelled form used consistently by Rainbow and ResearchGate. The record is confidently one person. Band is Medium: only ONE official domain carries him (rainbowhospitals.in - doctor page, speciality page, Banjara Hills sub-specialty listing and group roster, which per section 5 count as a single source). ResearchGate is corroborating-only and Skedoc is corroborating-only, so neither can lift the row to High. Note the ResearchGate entry is a 'scientific-contributions' stub rather than a claimed profile, and it lists an Apollo Hospitals affiliation alongside others - consistent with his stated BMT training at Apollo Cancer Centre, Chennai, and not a contradiction of his current Rainbow post. BROKER SOURCE EXPLICITLY REJECTED: a ZoomInfo page for 'Nalla Reddy' appeared prominently in results advertising a MASKED email of the form ****@rainbowhospitals.in plus a phone number. That is a scraped contact-broker database and the address is masked, so it is barred twice over by golden rule 4 - it was not recorded, and no attempt was made to complete the masked address. NO EMAIL OR PHONE RECORDED for the same reason as the other Rainbow rows: Rainbow publishes no per-doctor contact details, and the branch numbers that appeared in a WebSearch synthesised summary failed the mandatory exact-phrase re-check ('"9676838787"' returned only pages about the unrelated UH Rainbow Babies & Children's Hospital in Cleveland, Ohio), so they were discarded. The group helpline is supplied by the pipeline's hospital fallback. owns_clinic false - an 8-years-experience hospital consultant with no separate clinic entity found. RAINBOW URL PATTERN: this row is the best illustration that the specialty suffix can be very long and fully descriptive - '...dr-nalla-anuraag-reddy-pediatric-hematologist-oncologist-and-bone-marrow-transplant-physician'.
